notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Champions leaving Steam March 30th!
Solenars Edge II: Champions Final Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38294346/f9a096e23003ed831a3d9d248b08494c4945c938.jpg[/img]


Welcome to the last update to Solenars Edge II champions. Although this game didn't get updated as much as the others. It now has 78 total playable champions to collect, equip and battle alongside.

Here is what is new;

-Increased the winning chances of the slot machines in the Casino.

-Added in six new characters.
Haku and Lyla (Euclyca). Adelle (3rd Party Dev Cameo). Eska (A new character that is Nerine and
Rufus' child). Gizmo (If Soren and Maria had a son instead of a daughter in an alternate time line).
Lastly, Yien (A brand new character).

-Increased the amount of prize money of each rank in the Arena.


Well, that is all folks. Enjoy this game in the company of friends!

notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Champions Hotfix v1.1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38294346/60081d15e3d44c330239352646e618703430a424.png[/img]

Here is a quick fix to SE II: Champions.


-Removed some cutscenes during battles.

-Got rid of Assassin's Blade for Solen as it was way too OP and insta-killed fights.

-Velvet should no longer randomly leave your party during some ranks.

-Changed the main title theme.

-Changed the client icon from a random potion to Syetren.

-Fixed small various things and changed the co-op dialogue at the start a bit.

notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Champions v1.1 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38294346/f9a096e23003ed831a3d9d248b08494c4945c938.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the new and final update of Solenars Edge II: Champions.

Solenars Edge II: Champions v1.1 update.


Recently, I've been extremely overworked and have not been able to catch
a single break since the start of production of Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The
Seventh Dawn almost a year ago.

It's been a tough climb, one that doesn't quite seem
to end.

I do have to tackle all of these games on my own, which is why this game
will only obtain one update. But, hey. It's better than nothing.

I have other projects I am working on updating and other issues I am working on
resolving.

My main focus is on Euclyca now and I look forward to updating Aeloren
Tactics and Anetona one last time in the future. But for now. This is it for
Champions.

Here is what is new;

-Added in Clairena from Aeloren Tactics.

-Added in Seren from Aeloren Tactics.

-Added in Wanda from Aeloren Tactics.

-Added in the Sewer from Estellium Legends.

-Added in a new boss in the Sewer; Mr. Shark.

-Some hidden goodies.

*There is now a total of 72 playable characters.


That is about it for good. Sorry again for such a short update.

notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Champions coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38294346/f9a096e23003ed831a3d9d248b08494c4945c938.jpg[/img]
Instead of releasing the game on my birthday, I have something else planned, so I am moving the release date forward since the game has been finished for some time now!


Also, despite what the store page says, the game is in fact co-op with four players, just in another build.


Please look forward to the last Solenars Edge game that will ever be made, the last arena-based game that will ever be made and the last game made with RPG Maker MV. It's all about RPG Maker MZ now.
